title: admin-provisioning-routing-matrix-and-priority-playbook
creator: Nina Patel
description: Create a deterministic intake, prioritization, and routing playbook for enterprise admin & access requests (RBAC changes, SSO/SAML enablement, SCIM provisioning, org policy updates). Objective: reduce time-to-resolution for high-risk identity requests, automate first-pass routing, and provide clear SLA expectations for Support/SE/Product/Security handoffs. Deliverables: (1) a priority matrix and decision tree, (2) automated routing rules for Support and Solutions, (3) telemetry + dashboard for SLAs and backfill, (4) onboarding checklist and audit template for compliance reviews.
acceptance_criteria: Priority matrix defined and mapped to at least 6 inbound ticket archetypes (RBAC change, SSO enable, SCIM sync, org split, emergency admin escalation, third-party IAM request)
Routing rules prototyped in Support queue: automatic assignment to Solutions for high-complexity and to Eng-ops for infra-affecting requests
SLA tiers documented and enforced in triage: P0 (security incident) 4h, P1 (enterprise admin) 2 business days, P2 7 business days
Telemetry: dashboard shows median time-to-first-respondent and resolution by archetype and customer tier
Confluence playbook + checklist published and linked in intake form; Security sign-off workflow added for requests with elevated privilege
comments: 2026-02-10 | Nina Patel: Initial draft created after customer escalations from two enterprise accounts requesting expedited RBAC changes during onboarding. Noted ambiguity in current intake form that causes misrouting to general Support.

2026-02-18 | Luca Moretti: Scoped work with Solutions Engineering — will prototype routing rules using metadata tags: 'privilege_change', 'sso_enable', 'scim_provision'. Proposed to add 'regulatory' tag for HIPAA/GDPR customers.

2026-02-25 | Priya Shah (Security): Flag - any request that grants organization-level admin must require KMS audit and 2-person approval. Recommend adding automated escalation to Security for these cases.

2026-03-03 | Alex Rivera (Support Lead): We trialed the routing prototype for 72 hours. Observations: 18% of RBAC tickets still misclassified due to missing tenant metadata. Action: add tenant-level intake field and require SSO domain validation.

2026-03-07 | Luca Moretti: Implemented updated intake form (v2) in Zendesk sandbox and pushed rules to route by metadata. Created PR for the routing definitions repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/support-routing/pull/42

2026-03-09 | Nina Patel: Decision meeting notes: (1) adopt 3-tier SLA, (2) require SCIM requests to include sample mapping CSV, (3) pilot automated routing for Enterprise customers for two weeks starting 2026-03-15. Next: finalize Confluence playbook and get Security approval by 2026-03-12.
decisions: Adopt metadata-first routing: require 'request_type' and 'tenant_security_level' fields on intake to enable deterministic routing
SLA tiers: P0=4 hours (security incident), P1=2 business days (enterprise admin/config changes), P2=7 business days (low-impact requests)
Security review required for organization-level admin grants and SCIM writes to user stores
Pilot focused on Enterprise customers only for initial two-week rollout; General availability after metrics validate <24h median first response for P1
tradeoffs: Tighter intake validation reduces misrouting but increases friction for small customers — decided to gate stricter fields only for 'Enterprise' checkbox
Automating routing reduces manual toil but increases dependence on accurate tenant metadata — mitigation: add support validation step and backfill job for missing metadata
Requiring sample SCIM mappings speeds security review but may slow customer submit time — mitigated by providing a template and fill-assist wizard
next_steps: Secure Security team sign-off on checklist by 2026-03-12 (owner: Priya Shah)
Deploy intake v2 to staging and run 72h pilot routing for tenant with Enterprise flag (owner: Alex Rivera)
Instrument dashboard with three core metrics: time-to-first-response, time-to-resolution, misroute-rate (owner: Data-Infra)
Create customer-facing KB article and onboarding email snippet explaining expected SLAs and required artifacts for SCIM and SSO requests (owner: Docs)
Schedule post-pilot retrospective and decision to expand by 2026-03-29
